subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: For system-event-triggered heartbeat wakes, should an explicit `heartbeat.session` always override the originating session key, and should system events be migrated across sessions when that changes the run target?
rationale: Current main preserves the older forced-session priority, while the linked fix changes a compatibility-sensitive session-routing rule and migrates queued events; that affects existing heartbeat, exec, and channel workflows beyond a mechanical cleanup close.

options.title: Prioritize configured heartbeat session
options.body: Refresh/review the linked fix so `heartbeat.session` wins over originating-session wakes and migration is covered by focused tests.

options.title: Keep originating-session wake semantics
options.body: Reject the linked direction and document that `heartbeat.session` is not authoritative for event-originated immediate wakes.

options.title: Narrow to default-compatible opt-in
options.body: Preserve current behavior by default and add an explicit opt-in only if maintainers want a staged compatibility path.

recommendation.title: Prioritize configured heartbeat session
recommendation.body: Refresh/review the linked fix so `heartbeat.session` wins over originating-session wakes and migration is covered by focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main blame for the central heartbeat/session and exec wake code points to the latest area refactor by this person.
